answer.rationale: Primary region write latency is 5x target and climbing; settlement peak demands immediate relief. Regional failover (memory_b2) restored latency within minutes during prior degradation and can shift heavy write load instantly. Read replica routing (memory_b5) addresses reporting load but not transactional writes. Rollback is blocked by compliance-mandated security patch. Circuit breaker and capacity additions are too slow for active peak. Failover to secondary region preserves the security patch, maintains write consistency, and has proven fast recovery in similar conditions. Uncertainty preserved: secondary region capacity and cross-region write latency unknown until execution begins.
